description: Preserves original Unity Mesh object bytes and links each PathID to its reconstructed OBJ and validation records. Existing source files are not overwritten or moved.

summary.note: Geometry PASS does not mean attribute-clean. Non-unit normals, UV coordinates outside 0..1, and degenerate triangles are separately recorded per asset; UV tiling may be intentional and requires material/sampler context.

checksum_note: git_blob_sha is Git's blob object identifier, not a standalone SHA-256 checksum.
